decision_analysis.physical_core_vs_permanent_recipe: Core specimen is a finite physical instance; recipe knowledge is permanent. Research consumes the specimen; manufacture creates a new finite Core.

USE.gain: Potential field effect if A4 Gold skill is verified.
USE.risk: Finite uses may be spent without permanent recipe knowledge.
USE.permanent_loss: No recipe knowledge gained by casting alone.

STORE.risk: Opportunity cost: delayed manufacture/knowledge; storage/death risk if carried.

SACRIFICE.gain: Permanent recipe knowledge and future manufacture path.
SACRIFICE.risk: Destroys the physical specimen; requires spares/station/catalyst/reagents to regain a Core.
SACRIFICE.permanent_loss: The specific specimen instance is consumed.

required: same starting Core instance and session
A4-verified USE effect, uses, condition and risk delta
SACRIFICE confirmation warning and atomic consume
manufacture recipe cost and catalyst/reagent availability
time to replacement under active-session queue
encounter outcomes with and without USE
human valuation of permanent knowledge vs finite utility

adversity.early_loss: Bag items and bag-carried instances are lost on death; knowledge/home retained. No invisible protection.
adversity.targeted_fallback: After a lost specimen, targeted research may buy the recipe for 6 spares + 2 notes; it does not restore the physical Core.
adversity.blocked_routes: Route edges require A1 capabilities; safe approach has zero exposure; east shortcut requires cap_filter. Blocked routes force longer paths or stall.
adversity.missing_reagents: frost_resin/venom_sac/peat and tide/pressure resistance remain explicit gaps; no silent aliases.
adversity.limited_playtime: Active-session time only; no offline catch-up; unused budget is not engagement.
adversity.queue_uncertainty: Paused/interrupted station work persists as remaining active time; no free completion or duplicate grant.

missing_items.dependency: Power circuits, seal-2 forge, storm signal, pumps; first-hour relay uses a salvage/timber hand-crank bypass, so copper is not a first-hour softlock.
Boat hull seals, deepward/tide-ward insulation; mid-game traversal preparation.
Mortar, filter bed, grafting bed; A0 construction/A1 preparation gap.
Food/fermentation/trade; not required for the first-hour filter lesson.
Food preservation, flux, trade; Saffron logistics.
Seal inlay, trade, lens; access seals are credentials, not pearl crafts by default.
Glass furnace/lens path; prerequisite for storm_glass identity.
Signal tower/storm core; late Glasswind objective.
Precision cores/blades; late Embersteppe specialization.
Heat-proof construction; primarily A0 construction material.
Tier-3 seal/abyssal core; late Pearl objective.
Core blanks/power nodes; not interchangeable with ancient_catalyst without a design decision.

a4: tactical effects / risk reduction not modeled

product_findings.finding: Rare Core specimens are one-time POI discoveries, not flat timer loot.
USE/STORE/SACRIFICE changes permanent knowledge and physical Core availability; no Gold cast is executed.
Core manufacture is gated by knowledge_spares, ancient_catalyst, advanced workbench and family reagents.
frost_resin, venom_sac and peat remain unapproved; Frost/Venom manufacture must not silently consume A1 world keys as A3 items.
At least three late goals remain after the modeled journey; they are destinations, not proven engagement.
Poor loot, lost specimens, shortages, failed expeditions and limited playtime delay or block milestones rather than being averaged away.
